name: music-desktop
description: Navidrome and the music frontend packaged as one desktop app

scripts.test: node --test spotify.test.js spotify-library.test.js spotify-capture.test.js music-store.test.js history.test.js player.test.js && node --experimental-strip-types --test ../frontend/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.dist: pnpm prepare:build && pnpm navidrome && pnpm build:preload && pnpm build:frontend && electron-builder --config builder-config.json --linux --publish never && pnpm pack:portable
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm navidrome && pnpm build:frontend && pnpm pack:mac:dir && pnpm pack:mac && pnpm pack:portable
scripts.pack:mac:dir: pnpm prepare:build && pnpm build:native && pnpm build:preload && node scripts/package-mac.mjs --dir
scripts.dev:capture: pnpm build:native && pnpm build:preload && pnpm build:frontend && node scripts/repo-app.mjs && ./.local-app/Music.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Music uses Spotify audio on this Mac to animate the visualizer. Audio is never saved or uploaded.
